blocks.text: MANILA – Senator Robin Padilla on Friday appeared before the Department of Justice (DOJ) in Manila for a preliminary investigation into the obstruction of justice case filed against him, submitting his counter-affidavit in response to the complaint. The Philippine National Police-Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (PNP-CIDG) filed the complaint against Padilla over allegations that he […]...
